children: said Tuesday that its marketing subsidiary signed a 22-year agreement to supply liquefied natural gas to Brazilian state-controlled energy company Petrobras.

) will purchase about 800,000 metric tons of LNG annually from Cheniere Marketing. The LNG will be sold on a free-on-board basis, meaning Petrobras will take responsibility for shipping the fuel from Cheniere’s export facilities.

For investors, the agreement adds another long-term customer to Cheniere’s contracted LNG portfolio and provides greater visibility into future cash flow. The company said the contract will also provide commercial support for potential expansion of its existing liquefaction facilities, although it did not specify which expansion projects could be supported by the deal.
At the contracted volume, Petrobras would purchase roughly 17.6 million metric tons of LNG over the full 22-year term, assuming deliveries remain at 0.8 million tons annually.

Cheniere CEO Jack Fusco said the agreement extends the company’s relationship with a major energy buyer and provides additional fixed-fee cash flow visibility as Cheniere considers adding liquefaction capacity at existing sites.
The companies didn't disclose the contract’s financial value, pricing formula or when deliveries are scheduled to begin.

title: Cheniere signs 22-year LNG supply deal with Petrobras
